description: This file implements an I3C driver for NXP MCUX hardware, including bus recovery, transfer, configuration, and IBI handling.

methods.name: reg32_poll_timeout
methods.description: Polls a 32-bit register with timeout, checking for a masked value to match.

methods.name: reg32_update
methods.description: Updates specific bits in a 32-bit register.

methods.name: reg32_test_match
methods.description: Tests if masked bits in a register match a value.

methods.name: reg32_test
methods.description: Tests if all bits in mask are set in a register.

methods.name: mcux_i3c_interrupt_disable
methods.description: Disables all interrupts and returns previous mask.

methods.name: mcux_i3c_interrupt_enable
methods.description: Enables specified interrupts.

methods.name: mcux_i3c_has_error
methods.description: Checks if the controller has any error indicated in status.

methods.name: mcux_i3c_error_is_timeout
methods.description: Checks if a timeout error occurred.

methods.name: mcux_i3c_error_is_nack
methods.description: Checks if a NACK error occurred.

methods.name: mcux_i3c_state_get
methods.description: Retrieves current controller state.

methods.name: mcux_i3c_request_emit_start
methods.description: Commands the controller to emit a START condition.

methods.name: mcux_i3c_request_emit_stop
methods.description: Commands the controller to emit a STOP condition.

methods.name: mcux_i3c_ibi_respond_nack
methods.description: Commands the controller to NACK an IBI.

methods.name: mcux_i3c_ibi_respond_ack
methods.description: Commands the controller to ACK an IBI.

methods.name: mcux_i3c_fifo_rx_count_get
methods.description: Returns number of bytes in RX FIFO.

methods.name: mcux_i3c_fifo_flush
methods.description: Flushes TX and RX FIFOs.

methods.name: mcux_i3c_xfer_reset
methods.description: Resets transfer state, clears status and flushes FIFOs.

methods.name: mcux_i3c_device_find
methods.description: Finds a registered I3C device matching given ID.

methods.name: mcux_i3c_recover_bus
methods.description: Performs bus recovery by emitting STOP and handling IBIs.

methods.name: mcux_i3c_do_one_xfer_read
methods.description: Performs a read transfer from RX FIFO with timeout.

methods.name: mcux_i3c_do_one_xfer_write
methods.description: Performs a write transfer to TX FIFO with timeout.

methods.name: mcux_i3c_do_one_xfer
methods.description: Performs a complete transfer (read/write) with optional start/stop.

methods.name: mcux_i3c_transfer
methods.description: Handles multiple I3C messages transfer.

methods.name: mcux_i3c_do_daa
methods.description: Performs Dynamic Address Assignment (DAA).

methods.name: mcux_i3c_do_ccc
methods.description: Sends a Common Command Code (CCC).

methods.name: mcux_i3c_ibi_work
methods.description: Handles target-initiated IBI in workqueue.

methods.name: mcux_i3c_ibi_rules_setup
methods.description: Sets up IBI rules based on registered addresses.

methods.name: mcux_i3c_ibi_enable
methods.description: Enables IBI for a target device.

methods.name: mcux_i3c_ibi_disable
methods.description: Disables IBI for a target device.

methods.name: mcux_i3c_isr
methods.description: Interrupt handler for I3C controller, services IBIs.

methods.name: mcux_i3c_configure
methods.description: Configures I3C hardware with specified parameters.

methods.name: mcux_i3c_config_get
methods.description: Retrieves current hardware configuration.

methods.name: mcux_i3c_init
methods.description: Initializes I3C hardware and driver.
